sloka: न अध्यगच्चत् तदा पारम् शोकस्य कपि कुन्जरः ।रावणम् वा वधिष्यामि दशग्रीवम् महा बलम् ॥५-१३-४९॥
transliteration: na adhyagaccat tadā pāram śokasya kapi kunjaraḥ ।rāvaṇam vā vadhiṣyāmi daśagrīvam mahā balam ॥5-13-49॥

translations.english: "I will kill Ravana, this mighty, tenheaded demon. Sita was indeed carried away by him. This (killing him) can be a fitting reply to his evil action. My desire would be fulfilled.
